name: What is the difference between bay and bow window repair?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between bay and bow window repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: While both project outward from a home, bay windows typically feature a large central picture window flanked by two smaller angled windows, creating a more angular appearance. Bow windows usually have three to six identical windows arranged in a gentle curve. Repair techniques for both are similar for issues like glass replacement or frame rot. However, the specific components and structural considerations may differ due to their distinct shapes and construction. An assessment determines the precise repair needs for each type.
acceptedAnswer.description: Bay windows have a central window with angled sides, while bow windows form a gentle curve. Repair techniques are similar but component specifics vary due to their distinct shapes.
